name: Barbadillo de Herreros (Spain)
description: Square white flag with four triangles issuing from the hoist, red, black, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Barbadillo de Herreros (a castle, an anvil, a tree and a fleur-de-lis).
history: Municipal flag of Barbadillo de Herreros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
